product_one_liner.value: Momentus provides venue and event management software that unifies bookings, sales, event operations, finance, and analytics for convention centers, stadiums, arenas, performing arts venues, universities, and corporate campuses.

pricing_page.notes: Public tier descriptions are available; prices are quote-based.

eng_blog.notes: The general blog is marketing/product-led; one engineer-authored defense-in-depth post was found, not the two required to qualify.

public_docs.notes: Public Momentus Elite help articles cover operational workflows and product changes; some Enterprise documentation requires sign-in.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The nine listed openings contain no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title, as of November 9, 2026.

model_provider.notes: Momentus explicitly says its AI products are built on AWS Bedrock; it does not identify a single exclusive foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are explicit company certification claims. The ticketing page labels GDPR compliance as certified and claims PCI DSS-compliant infrastructure; these are public compliance claims, not independently verified certificates.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies the latest deal type as Debt - Acquisition but does not publicly disclose its date or amount. The reported $38.3 million is cumulative funding, not the latest round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: Outside funding is documented, but the latest debt financing date is not publicly disclosed in the sources reviewed, so funding within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 cannot be determined.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying title appears among the nine openings. Senior Account Manager is excluded under the requested title-based rule.

launched_6mo.notes: Momentus Ticketing launched May 28, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Liz Bernardo announced joining Momentus as Senior Vice President of Marketing on August 7, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales Operations names Salesforce as the primary platform, plus HubSpot and Gong; Customer Success names the additional customer/revenue systems.
